items.exampleEn: My grandfather built this wooden cabinet for his record collection.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺為了收藏唱片，親手做了這個木櫃。

items.exampleEn: The player was sent off for violating the rules of the game twice.
items.exampleZh: 那名球員兩度違反比賽規則，被罰下場。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor threatened to sue us if our tree fell on his roof.
items.exampleZh: 鄰居說，如果我們的樹倒在他家屋頂上，他就要告我們。

items.exampleEn: Her first film received three nominations for national awards.
items.exampleZh: 她的第一部電影獲得三項全國獎項的提名。

items.exampleEn: The bank asked for two forms of identification before opening my account.
items.exampleZh: 銀行在幫我開戶前，要求我出示兩種身分證明。

items.exampleEn: As a student ambassador, my sister shows visitors around her school.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹是學生大使，負責帶訪客參觀她的學校。

items.exampleEn: The museum authorized a film crew to shoot inside after closing time.
items.exampleZh: 博物館批准一個拍攝團隊在閉館後入內拍攝。

items.exampleEn: When my mother is busy, she delegates the cooking to my older brother.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽忙的時候，會把煮飯的工作交給我哥哥。

items.exampleEn: A certificate on the wall shows that the restaurant passed its safety check.
items.exampleZh: 牆上的證書顯示這家餐廳通過了安全檢查。

items.sentenceEn: Each class will send one delegate to the student meeting on Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 每班會派一位代表參加星期五的學生會議。

items.audioEn: Please bring your identification card to the front desk before you go upstairs.
items.audioZh: 上樓之前，請先帶身分證到櫃台。
options: Show their ID at the desk
Wait outside in the car park

items.sentenceEn: My little sister was very proud of her swimming certificate.
items.sentenceZh: 我妹妹對她的游泳證書感到非常驕傲。

items.sentenceEn: Taking photos inside the museum violates its rules.
items.sentenceZh: 在博物館內拍照違反館方規定。

items.stemEn: The company decided to ____ the shop that copied its logo.
items.stemZh: 那家公司決定控告抄襲它商標的店家。

items.stemEn: Who is in charge? Someone needs to ____ this payment before we can send it.
items.stemZh: 誰負責？必須有人核准這筆款項，我們才能付出去。

items.passageEn: This year, our school held its first student council election. Each class chose one delegate, and anyone could make a nomination for president. To vote, students had to show their identification card. One candidate, Mei, promised to become the school's ambassador for clean beaches. Another wanted new storage cabinets in every classroom. The teachers did not authorize any posters on the walls, because last year some posters violated the school's rules. After the vote, every delegate received a small certificate. Mei won, and she said she would delegate tasks fairly so that everyone could help.
items.passageZh: 今年，我們學校舉辦了第一次學生會選舉。每班選出一位代表，任何人都可以提名會長人選。投票時，學生必須出示學生證。其中一位候選人 Mei 承諾要擔任學校推廣乾淨海灘的大使。另一位候選人則希望每間教室都有新的收納櫃。老師們不准在牆上貼海報，因為去年有些海報違反了校規。投票結束後，每位代表都拿到一張小證書。Mei 當選了，她說會公平地分派工作，讓每個人都能幫忙。

questions.questionZh: 投票時，學生必須做什麼？
老師為什麼不准在牆上貼海報？

referenceEn: Please put the plates back in the cabinet.
Please return the plates to the cabinet.
rubricZh: cabinet 在這裡指櫥櫃（例如 in the cabinet）

items.promptZh: 完成這門課的學生都會拿到一張證書。
referenceEn: Students who finish this course will receive a certificate.
Everyone who completes the course will get a certificate.
rubricZh: certificate 指證書（例如 receive a certificate、get a certificate 等）
「會」可用表示未來的寫法或現在式（例如 will get、get 等）
「完成這門課的學生」可寫，例如 students who finish…、everyone who completes… 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似不自然："promised to make the school an ambassador for clean beaches"——ambassador 指人，學校當 ambassador 很牽強；中譯「推廣乾淨海灘的代表」也不通順。建議改成 promised to start a clean-beach project 之類，或讓學生擔任 ambassador。
